The structure of Lu₂Ga₂ (LuGa) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Immm (No. 216), with a unit cell containing four atoms and two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis shows both Ga and Lu centers with 12 geometric neighbors in close-packed-like local arrangements; Ga is surrounded by 8 Ga and 4 Lu, while Lu has 12 Ga neighbors. The resulting periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional, and validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among 12-vertex Ga and Lu coordination polyhedra.
